Name: Authentication framework
Description: The platform shall support pluggable authentication providers including passwordless, SSO, MFA, and enterprise identity federation.
Acceptance_Criteria: A tenant can configure approved providers and authentication policies without code changes.

Name: Session management
Description: The platform shall issue, refresh, revoke, and expire sessions with configurable risk and inactivity policies.
Acceptance_Criteria: Revoked or expired sessions cannot access APIs or user interfaces.

Name: Service identities
Description: The platform shall support non-human identities for integrations, jobs, and AI agents.
Acceptance_Criteria: Every service identity has explicit owner, scope, credentials, rotation, and audit history.

Name: Authorization service
Description: All protected platform actions shall use a centralized authorization decision service.
Acceptance_Criteria: Every decision returns allow or deny, matched policy, effective scope, and correlation ID.

Name: Device trust
Description: The platform shall register device posture and support risk-based access controls.
Acceptance_Criteria: Policy can require trusted devices for sensitive actions.

Name: Tenant context propagation
Description: Tenant context shall propagate through API, event, job, cache, search, file, and AI operations.
Acceptance_Criteria: No platform service may process a governed request without verified tenant context.

Name: Tenant data isolation
Description: All storage and query paths shall enforce tenant isolation.
Acceptance_Criteria: Cross-tenant access attempts are blocked, logged, and testable.

Name: Regional data placement
Description: Tenants shall support region selection and data-residency constraints.
Acceptance_Criteria: Configured regional placement is visible and enforced for governed data classes.

Name: Provisioning automation
Description: Tenant provisioning shall create required namespaces, defaults, indexes, storage, keys, and baseline configurations.
Acceptance_Criteria: Provisioning produces a validation report and rollback plan.

Name: Global identifier service
Description: The platform shall provide globally unique, non-guessable, immutable identifiers for governed records.
Acceptance_Criteria: Identifiers remain stable across versions, imports, exports, and integrations.

Name: Metadata framework
Description: Entities and fields shall support extensible metadata definitions without ungoverned schema changes.
Acceptance_Criteria: Metadata is versioned, validated, permissioned, and queryable.

Name: Universal tagging
Description: Users and automation shall apply governed tags to supported objects.
Acceptance_Criteria: Tags support ownership, scope, synonyms, lifecycle, and search.

Name: File and document service
Description: The platform shall store, version, classify, scan, preview, and secure files and documents.
Acceptance_Criteria: Every file version has checksum, owner, classification, retention, and access policy.

Name: Search service
Description: The platform shall provide permission-aware full-text and structured search.
Acceptance_Criteria: Search results never expose unauthorized records or snippets.

Name: Notification service
Description: The platform shall send in-app, email, SMS, push, and webhook notifications through governed templates and preferences.
Acceptance_Criteria: Every notification has delivery status, retry, deduplication, and audit.

Name: Scheduler service
Description: The platform shall schedule one-time and recurring tasks with tenant-aware execution.
Acceptance_Criteria: Schedules are versioned, observable, cancellable, and protected from duplicate execution.

Name: Background job service
Description: Long-running work shall execute through durable background jobs.
Acceptance_Criteria: Jobs support priority, retry, idempotency, progress, cancellation, dead-letter handling, and audit.

Name: Distributed cache
Description: The platform shall provide a tenant-aware cache with explicit key ownership, TTL, invalidation, and fallback behavior.
Acceptance_Criteria: Cache failure cannot corrupt source-of-truth data.

Name: Configuration service
Description: Runtime configuration shall be centrally resolved, versioned, validated, and auditable.
Acceptance_Criteria: Services can read effective configuration and subscribe to approved changes.

Name: Feature flag service
Description: Capabilities shall support tenant, user, percentage, environment, and effective-date feature flags.
Acceptance_Criteria: Feature rollout and rollback are controlled without redeployment.

Name: Workflow engine
Description: The platform shall orchestrate durable stateful workflows with timers, approvals, retries, and compensation.
Acceptance_Criteria: Workflow state survives service restart and can be inspected.

Name: Rules engine
Description: The platform shall evaluate versioned deterministic rules against declared inputs.
Acceptance_Criteria: Rule results are reproducible, explainable, and attributable to a rule version.

Name: State machine framework
Description: Governed entities shall support explicit state machines and allowed transitions.
Acceptance_Criteria: Invalid transitions are blocked and valid transitions emit events.

Name: Timer and SLA engine
Description: Workflows shall support due dates, timers, escalation, pause, resume, and calendar-aware SLAs.
Acceptance_Criteria: Timer behavior remains correct across time zones and downtime.

Name: API gateway
Description: External and internal APIs shall pass through a governed gateway.
Acceptance_Criteria: The gateway enforces authentication, authorization, versioning, throttling, request limits, and correlation.

Name: API versioning
Description: APIs shall use explicit versioning and deprecation policies.
Acceptance_Criteria: Breaking changes require a new supported version and migration notice.

Name: Webhook service
Description: The platform shall publish signed, retryable, tenant-scoped webhooks.
Acceptance_Criteria: Consumers can verify signature, replay protection, event ID, and delivery attempt.

Name: Event bus
Description: Platform domains shall publish durable versioned events through an event bus.
Acceptance_Criteria: Events have schema, tenant, producer, timestamp, correlation, causation, and idempotency keys.

Name: Connector framework
Description: The platform shall support governed connectors with credentials, scopes, mappings, health, and sync state.
Acceptance_Criteria: Connector actions are observable and independently disableable.

Name: Import engine
Description: The platform shall import structured data using mappings, validation, previews, errors, and resumable batches.
Acceptance_Criteria: No invalid row is silently accepted.

Name: Export engine
Description: The platform shall export authorized data to governed formats with filters and classification controls.
Acceptance_Criteria: Exports record requester, criteria, file, checksum, retention, and expiration.

Name: Mobile application shell
Description: The platform shall provide a reusable mobile shell for field workflows.
Acceptance_Criteria: The shell supports secure login, navigation, camera, location, notifications, and local storage.

Name: Offline data packs
Description: Authorized users shall download scoped offline data packs for field work.
Acceptance_Criteria: Offline packs are encrypted, time-limited, versioned, and revocable.

Name: Offline transaction queue
Description: Offline actions shall be queued locally with durable ordering and status.
Acceptance_Criteria: Queued changes preserve original user, device, timestamp, and correlation.

Name: Synchronization engine
Description: The platform shall synchronize offline and online changes with deterministic conflict handling.
Acceptance_Criteria: Sync results identify applied, rejected, merged, and manual-review changes.

Name: Attachment synchronization
Description: Files captured offline shall upload resumably with checksums and classification.
Acceptance_Criteria: Duplicate or corrupt uploads are detected.

Name: Structured logging
Description: All services shall emit structured logs with tenant-safe correlation fields.
Acceptance_Criteria: Logs exclude prohibited secrets and sensitive payloads by default.

Name: Metrics and health
Description: Services shall expose health, capacity, latency, error, and dependency metrics.
Acceptance_Criteria: Health checks distinguish startup, readiness, liveness, and degraded state.

Name: Distributed tracing
Description: Requests, events, jobs, workflows, and AI actions shall support distributed tracing.
Acceptance_Criteria: A correlation can be followed across service boundaries.

Name: Alerting framework
Description: Operational thresholds shall create deduplicated alerts with ownership and escalation.
Acceptance_Criteria: Alerts contain runbook, impact, severity, and supporting evidence.

Name: Encryption in transit
Description: All supported network communication shall use approved encrypted transport.
Acceptance_Criteria: Insecure transport is rejected except isolated approved development environments.

Name: Encryption at rest
Description: Governed data shall be encrypted at rest with managed keys.
Acceptance_Criteria: Key use, rotation, access, and failure are auditable.

Name: Secrets management
Description: Credentials and secrets shall be stored only in approved secret stores.
Acceptance_Criteria: Secrets are never persisted in source code, ordinary logs, or user-visible configuration.

Name: Malware and content scanning
Description: Uploaded content shall be scanned and quarantined based on policy.
Acceptance_Criteria: Unsafe content cannot be opened or distributed before disposition.

Name: Backup and restore
Description: The platform shall perform encrypted backups and tested restoration.
Acceptance_Criteria: Restore tests prove stated recovery point and recovery time objectives.

Name: Disaster recovery
Description: Critical services shall have documented failover, recovery, and communication procedures.
Acceptance_Criteria: Recovery exercises produce evidence and corrective actions.

Name: Rate limiting and abuse control
Description: The platform shall rate-limit and detect abusive API, login, export, and automation behavior.
Acceptance_Criteria: Controls can be scoped and do not expose cross-tenant information.

Name: Time zone framework
Description: All timestamps shall be stored in UTC and rendered using declared user or project time zones.
Acceptance_Criteria: Scheduling and due dates remain correct through daylight-saving transitions.

Name: Unit framework
Description: The platform shall support US customary and metric units with governed conversion and precision.
Acceptance_Criteria: Every quantity stores value, unit, precision, and conversion provenance.

Name: Currency framework
Description: Monetary values shall store currency and support governed conversion rates where required.
Acceptance_Criteria: No arithmetic combines different currencies without an explicit conversion.

Name: Language and locale
Description: The platform shall support locale-aware text, numbers, dates, and translations.
Acceptance_Criteria: Users can select supported locale without changing stored canonical values.

Name: Model gateway
Description: AI model calls shall pass through a governed model gateway.
Acceptance_Criteria: The gateway enforces model policy, tenant context, limits, logging, redaction, and fallback.

Name: Agent registry
Description: AI agents shall be registered with owner, purpose, version, permissions, tools, and evaluation status.
Acceptance_Criteria: Unregistered or disabled agents cannot execute.

Name: Tool execution service
Description: AI tools shall execute through permissioned, validated, observable adapters.
Acceptance_Criteria: Every tool invocation records input summary, output summary, result, duration, and correlation.

Name: Prompt and policy registry
Description: Prompts and AI policies shall be versioned, approved, testable, and rollbackable.
Acceptance_Criteria: Production execution identifies exact prompt and policy versions.

Name: Evidence and citation service
Description: AI outputs shall attach source references and evidence where required.
Acceptance_Criteria: Evidence remains resolvable to the authorized source version.

Name: AI evaluation framework
Description: Agents and prompts shall be evaluated for accuracy, safety, authorization, consistency, and business acceptance.
Acceptance_Criteria: Failed release gates prevent promotion.

Name: AI usage and cost metering
Description: The platform shall meter AI requests, tokens, tools, latency, errors, and cost by tenant and capability.
Acceptance_Criteria: Usage reports reconcile to gateway records.

Name: Platform event audit
Description: Material platform events shall be preserved in an immutable audit trail.
Acceptance_Criteria: Events can be correlated to request, actor, service, object, and tenant.

Name: Data portability
Description: Authorized tenants shall export core data and attachments in documented formats.
Acceptance_Criteria: Exports are complete, traceable, and do not include unauthorized shared data.
